content:
Mechanical Engineering students at the Instituto Tecnológico de Nuevo Laredo built their own go-kart from the classroom to the track — a mini-car prototype that took about three months to finish and reached about 40 kilometers per hour in testing, according to El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo.

Students Sebastián Carrasco and Luis Fernando Rivera were named as members of the team behind the vehicle. Their work covered weight distribution, design, welding and the motor, along with a renewed chassis and new parts including tires and turn signals, the report says.

The prototype was presented, evaluated and tested during the ITNLD's recently concluded Mechanical and Mechatronics Engineering Academic Week. The students thanked staff of the Metal-Mechanics Academy for their support, advice and experience, according to the report. No separate future race, venue or date was stated.

Sources:

  • El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo, "De las aulas a las pistas del Tecnológico; jóvenes de Nuevo Laredo fabrican go-kart," October 31, 2026
